headlines.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed, will air on NBC on Saturday morning
headlines.description: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be pushed back to Saturday because of severe weather, officials said. NBC News' Jesse Kirsch and Tom Winter discuss how public safety was "top priority" in Macy's decision. Telemundo's Gabriela Dellan has Saturday's weather for the parade.

headlines.title: Drone video captures smoke plume after controlled Iowa detonation
headlines.description: A drone captures the moment a plume of smoke rose into the air after the U.S. Army carried out a controlled detonation of a cache of lead explosives in Middletown, Iowa.

headlines.title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after he blasts coach Mike McCarthy in fiery exit interview
headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers released quarterback Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday shortly after he described his head coach Mike McCarthy as “unhealthy” in a critical interview following the Steelers’ decision to deactivate Rodgers for the team’s upcoming game.

headlines.title: Trump proposes new tariffs on China, the European Union and other trade partners
headlines.description: The trump administration is proposing a new round of tariffs on multiple countries, including China, European Union members and other U.S. trade partners. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the proposals and their potential economic impact.

headlines.title: Military families fight for fixes to healthcare program
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about the military families who say they are receiving bills they shouldn’t - in some cases - even as they are battling terminal illness.

headlines.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
headlines.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.

headlines.title: Plane Crashes Off Mississippi Coast, Killing All 6 Passengers
headlines.description: Six people, including two children, were killed Tuesday after their plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi. The Coast Guard says the bodies of all six people have been recovered, and the cause of the crash is under investigation.

headlines.title: Black Friday deals are here, and they’re actually really good — I’m tracking the best ones live
headlines.description: Black Friday officially starts in 48 hours, but deals are already live. Our shopping experts are live tracking what’s worth it at Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target and more.

headlines.title: How are you affording the holidays?
headlines.description: After a year of high gas prices, inflation ticking back up and a lot of Americans feeling pessimistic about the economy, we want to know how people are affording the annual wave of holiday gifts, travel and entertainment costs.

headlines.title: Too young to be vaccinated for measles? Babies face growing threats from outbreaks
headlines.description: As measles outbreaks continue to soar, a new question has emerged: Should doctors give measles shots earlier to better protect babies?

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade pushed back to Saturday due to weather
headlines.description: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be pushed back to Saturday because of severe weather, officials said.
